source.title: Cambridge B1 Preliminary for Schools Trainer · Exam Practice
source.selection: B1+–B2 useful vocabulary appearing on original Exam Practice pages; examples and explanations created for learning.

words.definition: made using moving drawings or computer images
words.definitionVi: hoạt hình; được tạo bằng kỹ thuật hoạt hình
words.example: The animated film was popular with younger children.
words.cloze: The ________ film was popular with younger children.

words.definition: the music recorded for a film
words.example: The film has a wonderful soundtrack with piano music.
words.cloze: The film has a wonderful ________ with piano music.

words.definition: following methods used for a long time
words.example: She prefers traditional drawings to computer animation.
words.cloze: She prefers ________ drawings to computer animation.

words.definition: someone who acts, sings or entertains in public
words.example: A famous performer sang the film's main song.
words.cloze: A famous ________ sang the film's main song.

words.definition: to happen or be played together with something
words.example: Soft piano music can accompany a peaceful film scene.
words.cloze: Soft piano music can ________ a peaceful film scene.

words.definition: very impressive and exciting to look at
words.example: The animation looked spectacular on a large screen.
words.cloze: The animation looked ________ on a large screen.

words.definition: knowing something because you have seen or experienced it
words.example: Most visitors are familiar with these classic games.
words.cloze: Most visitors are ________ these classic games.

words.definition: pictures and visual images used on a screen
words.example: The new game has clearer graphics than the old one.
words.cloze: The new game has clearer ________ than the old one.

words.definition: a person who wins a competition
words.example: She hopes to become a national diving champion.
words.cloze: She hopes to become a national diving ________.

words.definition: a place where people stay for holidays
words.example: The resort had a swimming pool with a diving board.
words.cloze: The ________ had a swimming pool with a diving board.

words.definition: to respect someone because of their ability or achievements
words.example: I admire athletes who train every day.
words.cloze: I ________ athletes who train every day.

words.definition: resting and becoming less worried
words.example: She started swimming for relaxation after school.
words.cloze: She started swimming for ________ after school.

words.definition: to hurt a person or a part of the body
words.example: A helmet can help protect you if you injure yourself.
words.cloze: A helmet can help protect you if you ________ yourself.

words.definition: to deal with a difficult situation successfully
words.example: After training, I knew I could handle the high jump.
words.cloze: After training, I knew I could ________ the high jump.

words.definition: a particular skill or method of doing something
words.example: The coach taught us a safer diving technique.
words.cloze: The coach taught us a safer diving ________.

words.definition: buildings and equipment provided for an activity
words.definitionVi: cơ sở vật chất; trang thiết bị
words.example: The sports centre has excellent training facilities.
words.cloze: The sports centre has excellent training ________.

words.definition: a chance to do something
words.example: Young divers need an opportunity to practise regularly.
words.cloze: Young divers need an ________ to practise regularly.

words.definition: relating to money
words.example: The team received financial support from an organisation.
words.cloze: The team received ________ support from an organisation.

words.definition: an event where objects are shown to the public
words.example: The museum organised an exhibition of old video games.
words.cloze: The museum organised an ________ of old video games.

words.definition: something interesting that people want to see
words.example: The computer game room is a popular attraction.
words.cloze: The computer game room is a popular ________.

words.definition: a practical class where people learn by doing
words.definitionVi: buổi học thực hành; hội thảo
words.example: Children joined a workshop on writing computer programs.
words.cloze: Children joined a ________ on writing computer programs.

words.definition: difficult to understand because there are many parts
words.example: Modern video games use complicated techniques.
words.cloze: Modern video games use ________ techniques.

words.definition: businesses producing a particular type of goods or service
words.example: The video game industry employs talented designers.
words.cloze: The video game ________ employs talented designers.

words.definition: having a sharp, unpleasant taste
words.example: Some children dislike the bitter taste of vegetables.
words.cloze: Some children dislike the ________ taste of vegetables.
